description: Which command x tag cells of the edit fixtures may stay empty, and why (spec section 9.2). `cargo xtask check-fixtures` fails when a cell has neither a fixture nor a reason here, or has both.

item.delete.clamp: A delete names whole items: there is no amount to limit.

timeline.ripple_delete.clamp: A delete names whole items: there is no amount to limit.

timeline.lift.clamp: Ranges are snapped and merged, never limited; a range past the end cuts nothing.

timeline.extract.clamp: Ranges are snapped and merged, never limited; a range past the end cuts nothing.

item.duplicate.clamp: Copies never shrink; where they go is a placement-mode question (reject, new_track, insert).

item.link.clamp: Linking changes no time or range.

item.unlink.clamp: Unlinking changes no time or range.

item.detach.clamp: Detaching changes no time or range.

track.set_magnetic.clamp: The flag has no amount; closing gaps closes them completely.
